$comment: Sandbox chapter for environmental combat (#201) — NOT content: it lives outside content/chapters/, no campaign lists it, and nothing ships it. One fight, four ways out of it: hold the landing (onVictory), go down (onDefeat), free Pip and get through the rift before it shuts (onEscape), or stay too long (onTimeout). The rift clock, a burning line you may cross but not stop on, a tear that opens in round 2 and shuts after round 4, a captive, and a shade the rift spits beside the way out. Played by packages/shared/src/encounter-environment.test.ts; judged by tools/content/encounter-environment.test.mjs.
title: The Drowned Ferry

objectives.label: Get Pip the ferry-sprite out of the rift

scene_landing.narration: The ferry is gone. Where it sank, the air has torn open like wet paper, and Pip the ferry-sprite is caught on the far side of it.

fight_rift.narration: Two rift shades rise out of the water. Above them, the tear begins to close.

onVictory.narration: The last shade comes apart like smoke.

onDefeat.narration: The water takes your feet from under you.

onEscape.narration: You dive through the tear as it snaps shut behind you.

variants.text: Pip tumbles through after you, lantern and all.
Behind you, Pip's lantern winks out.

onTimeout.narration: The tear folds shut, and the whole landing goes with it.

scene_held.narration: The landing is yours. The tear has closed, but the river is quiet.

scene_through.narration: You land in soft reeds on the other side of the rift.

scene_swept.narration: You wake on the bank, soaked and sore. The shades are gone, and so is the tear.

scene_collapse.narration: The rift throws you back onto the shore and seals itself.

variants.text: Pip did not come with you.
